summary: A Yes vote continues the town's paramedic services special tax for four years at up to $107.50 per residential unit or per 1,000 square feet of developed nonresidential property, adjustable up to $4.00 per year.

tax.text: A Yes vote extends and increases property taxes for paramedic services for four years.
tax.quote: Eight jurisdictions in central Marin County are asking voters to approve a four-year extension and increase of taxes for paramedic services.

tax.text: A No vote rejects the proposed four-year extension and increase of property taxes for paramedic services.
